newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury - Manufacturing outlook good in 2nd H/96.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury - Manufacturing outlook good in 2nd H/96.

text.p: UK Treasury Economics Secretary Angela Knight said small increases in manufacturing and overall industrial output during July confirmed the outlook for the sector in the second half of 1996 was brighter.
"Manufacturing prospects for the second of 1996 are good," she said in a statement after release of the data.

A Treasury spokesman said both the data and recent survey evidence backed official optimism the manufacturing sector was improving. The data showed a 0.5 percent monthly rise in total industrial output in July, while the June decrease was revised to 0.9 percent from a fall of 1.1 percent previously.
Manufacturing output was also up 0.5 percent, after a 0.3 percent fall in June.
